answer: Each bonded identity posts collateral in escrow, but identities that equivocate in a correlated pattern are treated as one coordinated set: the base penalty grows as O(k²) for k identities. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier across the set, so adding sybils magnifies exposure rather than dividing it. Asymmetric depreciation prevents rapid recovery of slashed stake—the tide may turn, but the ocean of lost capital thaws only like a glacier.
